questions.prompt: What is the name of the polynomial \(3 x - 2\) according to its degree?
questions.explanation: The highest power of \(x\) is \(1\), so the polynomial has degree \(1\): it is linear.

questions.prompt: A polynomial leaves remainder \(-2\) on division by \(x - 2\) and remainder \(3\) on division by \(x - 1\). Find the remainder on division by \((x - 2)(x - 1)\).
questions.explanation: The remainder has degree ≤ 1: \(r(x)=ax+b\). \(r(2)=-2\) and \(r(1)=3\) give \(a=-5,\ b=8\).

questions.prompt: Find the remainder when \(2 x^{3} + 4 x^{2} + x + 4\) is divided by \(x + 2\).
questions.explanation: The divisor \(x + 2\) is zero when \(x=-2\). By the Remainder Theorem the remainder is \(p(-2)=2\). (A common slip is to use \(p(2)\) = \(38\): the sign of c is opposite to the sign in the divisor.)
Try values that divide the constant term. \(p(-5)=0\) so \(x + 5\) is a factor; divide to get a quadratic and factorize it. Result: \((x + 5)(x + 2)(x - 5)\). Check by expanding.

questions.prompt: The polynomial \(k x^{2} + 2 x^{4} - 3 x^{3} + 5 x - 3\) leaves remainder \(5\) when divided by \(x - 1\). Find \(k\).
questions.explanation: Remainder \(=p(1)\). Substituting: \(k + 1=5\), which gives \(k=4\). Always substitute back to check.

questions.prompt: Divide \(2 x^{3} + 5 x^{2} + 8 x + 9\) by \(x + 2\). Find the quotient. (The remainder is \(-3\).)
questions.explanation: Long division: divide leading terms, multiply the whole divisor, subtract, repeat. The quotient is \(2 x^{2} + x + 6\) and the remainder is \(-3\). Check: \((x + 2)(2 x^{2} + x + 6)+-3=2 x^{3} + 5 x^{2} + 8 x + 9\).

questions.prompt: Without long division, find the remainder when \(- x^{3} - 4 x^{2} - x - 2\) is divided by \(x\).
questions.explanation: Divisor \(x\) gives \(x=0\). The remainder \(p(0)=-2\) is the constant term: no division needed.

questions.prompt: Find the remainder when \(3 t^{3} - t^{2} - 5 t - 4\) is divided by \(2 t + 2\).
questions.explanation: Set \(2 t + 2=0\): \(t=-1\). Remainder \(=p(-1)=-3\). For a divisor \(ax+b\) use \(x=-b/a\).

questions.prompt: Which of the following is a factor of \(x^{3} + 2 x^{2} - 16 x - 32\)?
questions.explanation: A factor \(x-c\) needs \(p(c)=0\). Test: \(p(-4)=0\), so \(x + 4\) is a factor. The others leave a non-zero remainder.
Try values that divide the constant term. \(p(-4)=0\) so \(x + 4\) is a factor; divide to get a quadratic and factorize it. Result: \((x + 4)(x + 2)(2 x - 1)\). Check by expanding.
Try values that divide the constant term. \(p(-6)=0\) so \(x + 6\) is a factor; divide to get a quadratic and factorize it. Result: \((x + 6)(x + 4)(x - 1)\). Check by expanding.

questions.prompt: Find the remainder when \(3 x^{3} - 3 x^{2} + 8\) is divided by \(x - 3\).
questions.explanation: The divisor \(x - 3\) is zero when \(x=3\). By the Remainder Theorem the remainder is \(p(3)=62\). (A common slip is to use \(p(-3)\) = \(-100\): the sign of c is opposite to the sign in the divisor.)

questions.prompt: Find the remainder when \(2 y^{3} + y^{2} - 4 y - 1\) is divided by \(y + 1\).
questions.explanation: The divisor \(y + 1\) is zero when \(y=-1\). By the Remainder Theorem the remainder is \(p(-1)=2\). (A common slip is to use \(p(1)\) = \(-2\): the sign of c is opposite to the sign in the divisor.)

questions.prompt: Find a polynomial with whose zeros are \(-4, -2, -5\).
questions.explanation: Each zero \(a\) gives a factor \(x-a\). Multiply: \(x^{3} + 11 x^{2} + 38 x + 40\). Any non-zero multiple has the same zeros.

questions.prompt: Find the value of \(k\) for which \(x + 3\) is a factor of \(k + 2 x^{3} + 6 x^{2} - 4 x\).
One zero of \(x^{3} + 8 x^{2} + 17 x + 10\) is \(-5\). Find the largest of the three zeros.
questions.explanation: \(x--5\) is a factor (since \(p(-5)=0\)). Dividing leaves a quadratic whose roots are \(-2\text{ and }-1\). The largest zero is \(-1\).

questions.prompt: The tickets sold in game number \(x\) are modelled by \(t(x)=x^{3} - 6 x^{2} + 27 x + 50\). How many tickets are sold in game \(6\)?
questions.explanation: Game number \(6\) means \(x=6\): \(t(6)=212\). This number is also the remainder when \(t(x)\) is divided by \(x-6\).

questions.prompt: Without long division, find the remainder when \(2 x^{3} - 7 x^{2} - 8\) is divided by \(x+1\).
questions.explanation: Divisor \(x+1\) gives \(x=-1\). The remainder \(p(-1)=-17\) is the alternating sum of the coefficients: no division needed.

questions.prompt: Find the remainder when \(2 x^{3} + 7 x^{2} - 2 x + 9\) is divided by \(x + 2\).
questions.explanation: The divisor \(x + 2\) is zero when \(x=-2\). By the Remainder Theorem the remainder is \(p(-2)=25\). (A common slip is to use \(p(2)\) = \(49\): the sign of c is opposite to the sign in the divisor.)

questions.prompt: Find the remainder when \(x^{4} + 3 x^{2} + 7 x + 1\) is divided by \(x - 3\).
questions.explanation: The divisor \(x - 3\) is zero when \(x=3\). By the Remainder Theorem the remainder is \(p(3)=130\). (A common slip is to use \(p(-3)\) = \(88\): the sign of c is opposite to the sign in the divisor.)

questions.prompt: Divide \(x^{3} - 8 x - 11\) by \(x + 2\). Find the quotient. (The remainder is \(-3\).)
questions.explanation: Long division: divide leading terms, multiply the whole divisor, subtract, repeat. The quotient is \(x^{2} - 2 x - 4\) and the remainder is \(-3\). Check: \((x + 2)(x^{2} - 2 x - 4)+-3=x^{3} - 8 x - 11\).

questions.prompt: Which of the following is a factor of \(x^{3} + 8 x^{2} + 11 x - 20\)?
questions.explanation: A factor \(x-c\) needs \(p(c)=0\). Test: \(p(1)=0\), so \(x - 1\) is a factor. The others leave a non-zero remainder.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is a zero of \(x^{3} - x^{2} - 25 x + 25\)?
questions.explanation: \(a\) is a zero of \(p(x)\) exactly when \(p(a)=0\). Here \(p(-5)=0\); for the other values \(p(a)\neq 0\).
